integrity: The analytic argument is the proof. A finite deterministic diagnostic verifies selected spherical-cap identities and skew witnesses, not all Hilbert spaces.
scientific_limitations: Real Hilbert targets and 0<delta<1. Exact index and regularization error require isometric reference; nonisometric norm-one references have the stated upper bound only. Priority is provisional pending broader human bibliographic review.
title: Sharp finite-tolerance Lipschitz numerical index for real Hilbert isometries
